audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer rates this TRICKY 7/10 and gives Taliyah rows 0-3 with rows 4-6 as "Skill", while content win[] and packet.levelChart both give Diana all seven and the win rate is 52.03% over 590 games.
audit.why: Taliyah's only self-mobility is Rock Surfing move speed near walls and Weaver's Wall at 180s rank 1 — Seismic Shove displaces you, it does not move her. Once Diana is inside 825 she has no escape, which is why every other source has Diana ahead at every stage.
audit.corrected: Even matchup: move all seven full-layer sides to Diana, difficulty 5.5/10, Taliyah carry threat 7/10.

audit.why: Level 3 mark-dash, level 6 Moonfall (100s) against a Weaver's Wall that is 180s at rank 1 and is a repositioning/zoning tool rather than an all-in, then first item and late reset chains. The ultimate asymmetry is large and the content layer already says so.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is nowhere on the page: Unraveled Earth's mines explode and stun enemies who DASH through them or are knocked through them, which makes Lunar Rush — Diana's entire pattern — the trigger. breakdown.cooldowns also has no digit in it.
audit.why: Riot's text for Unraveled Earth is explicit about dashes, and Seismic Shove exists to knock you into that minefield. That pairing, not the poke, is how Taliyah beats a Diana entry. E is a flat 14s at every rank and Seismic Shove is 14s at rank 1, so both are trackable.
audit.corrected: State the shove-into-mines stun in tldr, breakdown.cooldowns, phases[2].why and dontsFull[2].d with the 14s numbers.
sources: enemyKit E text and cd flat 14

audit.whatIsWrong: content early and content spikes[0].text both call Seismic Shove a wall/dash — "her W wall near jungle entrances" and "pre-positioned near a wall for her W dash". Neither is true.
audit.why: Seismic Shove throws enemies in a chosen direction; it has no self-movement. Weaver's Wall is the R, and the wall-adjacent speed is Rock Surfing (P).
audit.corrected: Both strings rewritten to name Weaver's Wall and Rock Surfing correctly.

edits.before: Taliyah's Threaded Volley poke has good range but low burst early, and once you're in melee range with Q-AA-W she has no escape unless she's pre-positioned near a wall for her W dash.
edits.after: Threaded Volley pokes from 1000 range but has low burst early, and in melee she has no escape — Seismic Shove throws you, it does not move her, and Rock Surfing only speeds her up near walls.

edits.before: Taliyah's poke can chip you down if you walk into her Threaded Volley range carelessly, but once you close the gap she has very little to punish your melee combo with. From level 3 onward you should be winning most trades since her damage is heavily front-loaded into skillshot poke rather than sustained melee trading. Watch for her W wall near jungle entrances since that's her main escape and zoning tool.
edits.after: Taliyah's poke can chip you down if you walk into her Threaded Volley range carelessly, but once you close the gap she has very little to punish your melee combo with. Her real escape is Weaver's Wall and the Rock Surfing speed she gains hugging jungle walls.
